_about: Module 5 repair-priority rules (transparent, adjustable heuristics based on common road-maintenance practice; see docs/MODULES.md).

grouping._about: A location = GPS cluster (records within radius_m), else a video time window, else a single photo.

score._about: priority score = (worst severity score + density bonus + safety bonus) * road factor, capped at 100

overrides._about: A (type, severity) pair forces at least this priority level.

D40_Pothole.Low: Monitor; fill with cold-mix asphalt during routine maintenance
D40_Pothole.Medium: Patch pothole: clean, tack coat, fill with hot/cold-mix asphalt, compact
D40_Pothole.High: Make safe immediately (cones/warning), then full-depth hot-mix patch

D20_Alligator_Crack.Low: Monitor; surface seal (slurry/chip seal) at next cycle
D20_Alligator_Crack.Medium: Skin patch or surface treatment over the cracked area
D20_Alligator_Crack.High: Full-depth patch; investigate base, subgrade and drainage

D10_Transverse_Crack.High: Rout and seal; inspect for base or joint failure

D00_Longitudinal_Crack.High: Rout and seal; check edge support and drainage
